definitions.explanation: The flat area on each side of the head between the forehead and the ear.

examples.japanese: こめかみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
こめかみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}さえる→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧。
こめかみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{白髪|しらが}→白髪：00369_shiraga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}えて→生える：02392_haeru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Gray hair has started to grow at my temples.

notes:
こめかみ refers to the flat area on each side of the head between the forehead and the ear. Usually written in hiragana; the kanji {米噛|こめかみ} exists but is rarely used.

ETYMOLOGY:
The name likely comes from the motion of this area when chewing rice (⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噛|か}む→噛む：01205_kamu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- こめかみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧: to have pain in one's temples
- こめかみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}さえる→押さえる：02021_osaeru⟧: to press one's temples
- こめかみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揉|も}む→揉む：00289_momu⟧: to rub one's temples
- こめかみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ズキズキ→ズキズキ：05262_zukizuki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a throbbing pain in one's temples

HEADACHE CONTEXT:
Often associated with tension headaches and migraines (⟦{偏頭痛|へんずつう}→偏頭痛：25441_henzutsuu⟧). People commonly press or massage this area to relieve pain.

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- ⟦{額|ひたい}→額：03579_hitai⟧: forehead
- ⟦{頬|ほほ}→頬：00110_hoho⟧: cheek
- ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧: ear
